review.editorial: Separate reread refined object handling, timing and concrete action before encoding. Revised Chinese was reread for physical continuity and close viewpoint, then companion English reviewed for natural dialogue.
review.continuity_or_facts: Checked prior actual ending, elapsed days, mobility, belongings, and what each speaker knows. Verified the previous chapter offers the correct next title in the reader.
review.english_alignment: Checked 58 units and 413 chunks against retained Chinese, exact English spans and natural clause boundaries. Corrected contextual pronunciation before release, with counterexamples and a fresh validation. Saved sentence and Listen source units inspected without speech.
